name: claude-code-respeak
description: Two-lane communication for agent swarms: governed shorthand lexicon + multi-register human-narrative translator.

plugins.name: respeak
plugins.description: Translator subagent rendering agent/swarm output as ELI5, BLUF, or technical narratives with configurable tone and tech level, resolved from a layered config (user, project, per-folder .respeak.yaml; nearest wins); a ratified shorthand lexicon with proposal workflow; style gates (234 banned AI-isms, replacement rules) compilable to Vale. Provides /respeak:respeak, /respeak:init, /respeak:off and /respeak:on (session overrides), /respeak:report (file a GitHub issue upstream), hooks, a statusline segment, and the respeak-config resolver.
